$comment: Each mutant removes one guard (kind guard), breaks one timing or lock assumption (kind assumption), or removes a guard that is defense in depth at these bounds (kind survivor, expect survives). `spec` edits a copy of the model and TLC must report `expect`. `code` makes the same edit to the implementation; the named test must fail under it and pass without it. Run: bun scripts/spec/mutants.ts [--spec-only|--code-only] [--only <id>]. See spec/tla/README.md.

mutants.title: a holder keeps the row FOR SHARE from overlapping transactions (sync lanes), so new share locks keep overtaking the waiting renewal until the lease lapses
the fence ignores an aborted lease signal
mutants.reason: Defense in depth: every abort is also visible to the fence's token or expiry check (the local deadline never outlasts the row's expiry, and a refused renewal means the token moved).

mutants.title: the fence admits under an expired row that nobody took over
mutants.reason: Defense in depth: FOR SHARE blocks a takeover while the transaction is open, and the token check refuses after one. test/persistence-sync-lease.test.ts still pins the refusal ("expired untaken").
